question.text: What is the payoff for a long call option holder at expiry when spot is below the strike price?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 81 of the source explains that if spot is below the strike at expiry, the long call expires unexercised because payoff = max(spot - strike, 0) = 0. The holder simply lets the option lapse. The Trap: Payoff and net P/L are not the same — the payoff is zero, but the net P/L equals the negative of the premium paid, since the buyer still spent the premium upfront. Note: The page 81-82 table keeps payoff (gross) and profit/loss (net of premium) in separate columns; never conflate them.
